description: This file defines utilities and classes for Linux socket operations within the QUIC protocol implementation, including message headers, packet writing, and socket configuration.

classes.name: QuicMsgHdr
classes.description: Builds msghdr objects for sending packets via sendmsg, supporting IPv4 and IPv6.

classes.name: BufferedWrite
classes.description: Holds information for a single packet to be sent.

classes.name: QuicMMsgHdr
classes.description: Builds mmsghdr objects for sending multiple packets via sendmmsg.

classes.name: QuicLinuxSocketUtils
classes.description: Provides static utility functions for Linux socket operations, including UDP segment size, release time, TTL, and packet sending.

methods.name: SetIpInNextCmsg
methods.description: Sets IP info in the next control message.

methods.name: GetNextCmsgData
methods.description: Retrieves pointer to the next control message data.

methods.name: GetNextCmsgDataInternal
methods.description: Internal method to get control message data.

methods.name: num_bytes_sent
methods.description: Calculates total bytes sent in the first specified number of packets.

methods.name: InitOneHeader
methods.description: Initializes a single message header for a BufferedWrite.

methods.name: GetUDPSegmentSize
methods.description: Returns UDP segment size for a socket.

methods.name: EnableReleaseTime
methods.description: Enables release time feature on a socket.

methods.name: GetTtlFromMsghdr
methods.description: Extracts TTL value from msghdr if present.

methods.name: SetIpInfoInCmsgData
methods.description: Sets IP address info in cmsg data.

methods.name: SetIpInfoInCmsg
methods.description: Fills cmsg with IP address info.

methods.name: WriteMultiplePackets
methods.description: Sends multiple packets using sendmmsg if supported.
